baselineSource: Score Policy 2.0 frozen artifacts plus Phase 5A.6.2 Option C reconciliation; historical candidate replay remains unchanged.

modifierResolver.triggerOrder: First matching rule by declared rule order; one trigger rule per Radar, except Security default bias plus at most one topical trigger.

matching.fields: NFKC-normalized title and entity, concatenated with a newline.
matching.ordinaryTerms: Literal substring matching; phrase and token boundaries are not inferred.
matching.securityTerms: Whole-token matching for every Security term; token characters are ASCII letters and digits, and every other character is a delimiter.
matching.aiAssisted: The hyphen is a delimiter, so AI-assisted contains the whole token ai and matches.

appUnrelatedRule.appliesWhen: radar=app AND relevanceLevel=UNRELATED AND a negative App trigger matches
appUnrelatedRule.effect: Replace that negative trigger component with 0; preserve the match in debug provenance.

securityComposition.topicalTrigger: +3 for the first whole-token match among ai, mcp, agent, gecko.
securityComposition.formula: default bias + one topical trigger (if any), then clamp to [-10, 10].

output.modifierReason: Debug only; must not be consumed by scoring decisions.
output.clamp: Apply once to the sum of modifier components; clamp inclusively to [-10, 10].

evaluationOrder: Validate Radar and read explicit title/entity/relevanceLevel inputs.
Normalize title/entity using NFKC and en-US lowercase.
Match ordered Radar-specific rules, stopping after the first matching rule.
For Security, add the default bias and then the first whole-token topical trigger, if any.
For App negative trigger with UNRELATED relevance, emit a zero component.
Sum components, clamp modifier, and produce provenance/debug output.
Pass radarModifier independently to Score Policy; do not feed provenance to scoring.
